desc:
Welcome to Steal the Dumpling Squishy! 🥟

How to Play:
• Buy Squishy Dumplings as they walk down the path!🛒
• Race your rivals and snipe a Dumpling Squishy before it reaches their base!⚡
• Break into other players' bases and grab their Squishy Dumplings!🔓
• Lock your base to protect your loot from thieves!🔒
• Collect tons of cash from your Squishy Dumplings💸
• Upgrade your characters to earn even more🔥
• Expand your plot to unlock extra slots🏗️
• Trade & gift Squishy Dumplings with friends to grow together!🎁
• Complete your Index to unlock cash boosts & base colors!📖
• But watch out... rivals can rob YOUR base too!🚨

Remember, your Squishy Dumplings earn cash even while you're offline!⏰
